title: Strict component equalities for point cone lifts
statement: The strict quotient units, inverse-image theta lifts, both Roos coordinates, section comparison, and induced naturality equalities appearing as the first five conjuncts of the point-cone lift naturality theorem hold simultaneously.

source.place: clause (3), point-transport comparison supplement; original steps 1--7 before the final transported-lift composition

proof.text: Prove the five displayed component groups by the sectionwise pure-tensor formulas for reduction and inverse-image comparison, the signed mapping-cone lift equations, the two-coordinate diagonal Roos map formulas, normalized section comparison, and naturality of all finite reductions. The zero shifted coordinates follow from the zero homotopy in each mapping-cocone lift. Sheafification uniqueness upgrades the sectionwise calculations to strict chain-map equalities.
